Can I purchase an Azure phone today?

This is an interactive design showcase. Products and prices are concept content, and checkout is not available yet. You can explore models and build a preview bag.

Which Azure is right for me?

The One concept focuses on a compact everyday experience. The One Pro concept explores a larger display, additional camera and more storage. Compare the proposed details above.

What about delivery, returns and warranty?

Delivery availability, return terms and warranty coverage will be added when the real product catalog and store policies are confirmed.
